info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-Create Rideshare Rides Request-v4-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Ride Request API allows users to initiate requests for rides within the rideshare ecosystem. This API serves as a crucial interface for submitting ride requests, enabling users to connect with drivers efficiently. It supports a variety of use cases, including booking rides for personal or business travel. Developers can integrate this API into mobile applications or web platforms to enhance user experiences in managing rideshare activities.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to request a new ride by providing the necessary details. Ensure all required parameters are included for successful processing.

requestBody.description: Submit a request for a ride. This body contains the necessary information required to process the ride request, including pick-up and drop-off locations, passenger details, and any additional preferences. Ensure that all required fields are filled out correctly to avoid processing delays.
